metadata.description: The policy effect. DeployIfNotExists remediates non-compliant tables, AuditIfNotExists only reports them, Disabled turns the policy off.
Analytics (interactive) retention in days for the Application Insights tables. Allowed range is 4-730. Defaults to 90 (free with workspace-based Application Insights).
Total retention in days (analytics + long-term) for the Application Insights tables. Valid values are 4-730, or 1095, 1460, 1826, 2191, 2556, 2922, 3288, 3653, 4018, 4383. Defaults to 90.
